description: Main source code for sensor data acquisition and display on the X-NUCLEO-IKS02A1 platform using Zephyr RTOS, handling multiple sensors with trigger and polling configurations.

methods.name: iis2dlpc_trigger_handler
methods.description: Handler for IIS2DLPC sensor trigger events, fetches accelerometer data.

methods.name: iis2mdc_trigger_handler
methods.description: Handler for IIS2MDC sensor trigger events, fetches all sensor data.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_acc_trigger_handler
methods.description: Handler for ISM330DHCX accelerometer trigger events.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_gyr_trigger_handler
methods.description: Handler for ISM330DHCX gyroscope trigger events.

methods.name: iis2dlpc_config
methods.description: Configures IIS2DLPC sensor sampling frequency and trigger.

methods.name: iis2mdc_config
methods.description: Configures IIS2MDC sensor sampling frequency and trigger.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_config
methods.description: Configures ISM330DHCX sensor sampling frequencies and triggers.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing sensors, fetching data, and displaying sensor readings in a loop.
